userStories.title: Promote greenfield and full-suite gates into StoryOrchestratorBuilder
userStories.description: Promote greenfield and full-suite gates into first-class builder phases so phase ordering and short-circuit behavior are owned by StoryOrchestratorBuilder and CANONICAL_ORDER. Keep full-suite gate internal rectification behavior as-is for this story and defer unification to US-006.
acceptanceCriteria: CANONICAL_ORDER includes greenfield-gate after test-writer and full-suite-gate after implementer.
ExecutionPlan.run() short-circuits remaining phases when either gate returns success=false.
fullSuiteGateOp output status supports: passed, rectification-exhausted, disabled, execution-failed, inconclusive.
When full-suite execution is skipped by config gate/feature toggle, output status is disabled with success=false and zeroed attempts.
When full-suite command/process invocation fails before parseable test results, output status is execution-failed with success=false.
When full-suite output is present but cannot be confidently classified as pass/fail by parser/recover logic, output status is inconclusive with success=false.
fullSuiteGateOp fallback/recover preserves structured failure output and does not collapse all failures to a single status.
greenfieldGateOp input is self-contained (story, workdir, resolvedTestPatterns) and does not consume prior phase outputs.

userStories.title: Introduce PlanInputs assembly with explicit boundary validation
userStories.description: Create PlanInputs and assemblePlanInputs as a typed boundary for all orchestrator slots. Add explicit validation behavior for missing/invalid context fields to prevent hidden null propagation during plan construction.
acceptanceCriteria: PlanInputs includes testWriter, greenfieldGate, implementer, fullSuiteGate, verifier, semanticReview, adversarialReview, rectification.
assemblePlanInputs validates required data before returning PlanInputs.
Missing resolved test patterns produces a deterministic structured failure (no implicit non-null assertion behavior).
Invalid or missing config required for slot input derivation produces a deterministic structured failure.
Boundary validation failures use a canonical contract: throw NaxError with machine-readable code and context.stage='execution-inputs'.
Validation behavior is covered by targeted unit tests.

escalations.reason: Reviewer contradiction: AC3 requires `assemblePlanInputs` to throw when resolved test patterns are missing, but the test at `test/unit/execution/plan-inputs.test.ts:212-220` explicitly asserts the function succeeds without test patterns (comment: "Test pattern validation is deferred to downstream orchestrator setup"). These two requirements are mutually exclusive and cannot both be satisfied without modifying test behavior.

reviewFindings.message: AC3 requires that missing resolved test patterns produce a deterministic structured failure. The implementation explicitly defers test pattern validation to the downstream orchestrator (line 59: 'Test pattern validation is deferred to the downstream orchestrator'). The function returns a valid PlanInputs even when no test patterns have been resolved, producing no failure. The unit test at plan-inputs.test.ts:82-86 confirms this: 'Test pattern validation is deferred to downstream orchestrator setup — assemblePlanInputs validates only the boundary contract.' This is an intentional design deviation from the AC.
reviewFindings.suggestion: Either add explicit validation for resolved test patterns (e.g., accept them as a parameter and throw NaxError when missing), or update the AC to reflect the deferred design.

userStories.title: Unify sequencing via buildPlanForStrategy
userStories.description: Replace duplicated sequencing paths with a single strategy-driven plan builder. Strategy only controls slot inclusion; actual ordering remains owned by CANONICAL_ORDER and builder dispatch.
acceptanceCriteria: buildPlanForStrategy accepts testStrategy as an explicit parameter and does not read it from NaxConfig.
Fresh TDD run includes test-writer and greenfield-gate; retry run omits both and still runs implementer.
TDD strategies include full-suite-gate and verifier; non-TDD strategies omit them.
Review phase selection is controlled by config.review.checks membership (semantic/adversarial), not nested enabled flags.
Rectification slot inclusion is gated by shouldRunRectification(config).
Slot composition logic is covered with table-driven tests.

userStories.title: Collapse execution stage to single plan run plus post-run inspection
userStories.description: Refactor execution stage to assemble inputs, build one plan, run once, then perform read-only post-run inspection for verdict/rollback/isolation/pause handling. Remove branch-level sequencing duplication.
acceptanceCriteria: execution stage builds exactly one plan and executes exactly one plan.run().
execution stage contains no sequencing branch that chooses between TDD and non-TDD orchestration implementations.
post-run inspection handles verdict extraction, failure categorization, rollback trigger, isolation surfacing, and pauseReason handling.
pauseReason produces interaction notify and stage action pause when interaction is enabled.
Source guard: src/pipeline/stages/execution.ts contains no direct orchestration dispatch calls (no callOp, no runWithFallback, no SessionKeeper constructor) outside plan-run helper paths.

userStories.title: Retire legacy TDD surfaces and migrate tests in mergeable increments
userStories.description: Remove legacy orchestration entrypoints and migrate tests in small, mergeable slices: behavior-preserving test ports first, API surface removals second, and type rename cleanup last.
acceptanceCriteria: Slice A: behavior tests are migrated to consolidated entrypoints and pass without changing expected semantics.
Slice B: path-specific shape tests for removed internal APIs are retired.
Slice C: runThreeSessionTdd and runFullSuiteGate exports/usages are removed from src and test trees.
Slice D: ThreeSessionTddResult is renamed/migrated to StoryRunResult and callers are updated.
Slice E: cleanup of obsolete helpers/imports/docstrings is completed with no lingering references in src/ and test/.
Each slice is independently mergeable and keeps main branch green (typecheck, lint, targeted tests).

analysis: This PRD uses PRD-CD as the baseline architecture and consolidation direction, while importing two safeguards from PRD-CC: (1) preserve richer full-suite gate failure status taxonomy and recovery semantics for accurate triage, and (2) explicitly validate PlanInputs assembly boundaries to prevent null/undefined propagation using a canonical NaxError contract. Work is split into 5 incremental, mergeable slices to reduce blast radius: gate promotion, input validation boundary, strategy plan builder, execution-stage collapse, and legacy-surface retirement/test cleanup.
